scene: Inside the rumbling cab, miniature rainclouds leak through the open dashboard vents.
beats: A cheerful electric jingle blares through harmless static sparks just as the truck brakes smoothly inside the buzzing, glowing neon workshop, pop-sliding the cab doors wide.
You scoop the cool puff into your palm where it tickles into sweet lime drizzle, just as the truck halts among giant luminous letters and the doors swing open.
Inside lies a glowing glass tube shaped like an ampersand, which you carefully pocket right as the truck halts inside the glowing workshop and the doors clunk open.
picture: Inside the flat-bench tow truck cab. A burly driver steers on the far left next to a glowing radio dial. The player sits centre in his corduroy jacket and beanie. Up high drifts a tiny raining cloud. On the right bench sits a green toolbox, with rooftop tanks visible through windows.
shown: a crackling dashboard radio with a glowing red dial on the left
a tiny puffy grey stormcloud drifting near the ceiling up high
a dented metal toolbox latched shut on the bench seat at the right

after.beat: You stay put as the truck cruises past Neon Sign Hospital, breezing under a sparkling sky. At the terminal, you hop a whistling mail train straight to the bustling Lost Property Depot.
after.then: Step off at Lost Property Depot
